supplier-review.source:
<#
.SYNOPSIS
Turns an HTML supplier table into an editable Word review, PDF and Excel workbook.
.DESCRIPTION
PSParseHTML selects table id="offers". PSWriteOffice creates the documents.
The bundled input is synthetic. Prices use invariant decimal notation without group
separators and USD per unit. Up to 15 significant digits and 28 fractional places
are accepted, ignoring leading zeros and fractional padding zeros. Sub-cent prices
remain visible in both reports.
.EXAMPLE
./Recipe-HtmlSupplierReview.ps1 -OutputDirectory ./Output/SupplierReview
.EXAMPLE
./Recipe-HtmlSupplierReview.ps1 -HtmlPath ./MyOffers.html -OutputDirectory ./Output/MyReview
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string] $OutputDirectory,
    [string] $HtmlPath
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
if (-not $OutputDirectory) { $OutputDirectory = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Output/SupplierReview' }
if (-not $HtmlPath) { $HtmlPath = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Input/SupplierOffers.html' }
Import-Module PSParseHTML -MinimumVersion 3.0.3 -ErrorAction Stop
Import-Module PSWriteOffice -MinimumVersion 3.0.8 -ErrorAction Stop

$priceTextFormat = '0.00##########################'
$tables = @(ConvertFrom-HtmlTable -Path $HtmlPath -TableId offers -IncludeMetadata)
if ($tables.Count -ne 1 -or @($tables[0].Data).Count -eq 0) {
    throw 'Supply one nonempty HTML table with id="offers".'
}
$offers = @($tables[0].Data | ForEach-Object {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($_.Item) -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($_.Supplier)) {
        throw 'Each offer needs Item and Supplier values.'
    }
    [decimal] $price = 0
    if (-not [decimal]::TryParse($_.UnitPriceUsd, [Globalization.NumberStyles]::AllowDecimalPoint, [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture, [ref] $price)) {
        throw 'UnitPriceUsd must be a nonnegative dot-decimal price without group separators.'
    }
    # Inspect the input, not the parsed value: Decimal.TryParse can round tiny quotes to zero.
    $priceParts = ([string] $_.UnitPriceUsd).Split('.')
    $fraction = if ($priceParts.Count -eq 2) { $priceParts[1].TrimEnd('0') } else { '' }
    $significantDigits = ($priceParts[0].TrimStart('0') + $fraction).TrimStart('0')
    $fractionalPlaces = $fraction.Length
    if ($significantDigits.Length -gt 15 -or $fractionalPlaces -gt 28) {
        throw 'UnitPriceUsd supports at most 15 significant digits and 28 fractional places, ignoring leading zeros and fractional padding zeros, so Word and numeric Excel quotes agree.'
    }
    $days = [int]::Parse($_.LeadDays, [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
    if ($price -lt 0 -or $days -lt 0) { throw 'Prices and lead times must be nonnegative.' }
    [pscustomobject]@{ Item = [string] $_.Item; Supplier = [string] $_.Supplier; UnitPriceUsd = $price; LeadDays = $days }
})
$reviewRows = $offers | Select-Object Item, Supplier,
    @{ Name = 'USD per unit'; Expression = { $_.UnitPriceUsd.ToString($priceTextFormat, [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture) } },
    @{ Name = 'Lead days'; Expression = { $_.LeadDays } }
$itemCount = @($offers | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Item -Unique).Count

$null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $OutputDirectory -Force
$OutputDirectory = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $OutputDirectory).FullName
$docx = Join-Path $OutputDirectory 'SupplierReview.docx'
$pdf = Join-Path $OutputDirectory 'SupplierReview.pdf'
$xlsx = Join-Path $OutputDirectory 'SupplierOffers.xlsx'

New-OfficeWord -Path $docx {
    WordHeader -Type Default { WordParagraph -Text 'PROCUREMENT / OFFER REVIEW' }
    WordFooter -Type Default { WordPageNumber -IncludeTotalPages }
    WordParagraph {
        WordParagraphStyle -SpacingAfterPoints 12 -KeepWithNext $true
        WordText 'Supplier offer review' -Bold -FontSize 26 -Color '17365D'
    }
    WordParagraph {
        WordParagraphStyle -SpacingAfterPoints 10
        WordText "$($offers.Count) offers / $itemCount items" -Bold -FontSize 16 -Color '166534'
    }
    WordParagraph -Text 'Compare price and delivery together. The workbook retains numeric values for your own calculations.'
    WordParagraph {
        WordParagraphStyle -SpacingBeforePoints 16 -SpacingAfterPoints 8 -KeepWithNext $true
        WordText 'Offers received' -Bold -FontSize 15 -Color '17365D'
    }
    $table = WordTable -InputObject $reviewRows -Style GridTable4Accent1 -Layout AutoFitToWindow -PassThru
    $table | Get-OfficeWordTableCell | ForEach-Object {
        $_.MarginTopCentimeters = 0.14; $_.MarginBottomCentimeters = 0.14
        $_.MarginLeftCentimeters = 0.16; $_.MarginRightCentimeters = 0.16
    }
    WordParagraph {
        WordParagraphStyle -SpacingBeforePoints 16 -SpacingAfterPoints 8 -KeepWithNext $true
        WordText 'Before choosing an offer' -Bold -FontSize 15 -Color '17365D'
    }
    WordList -Style Bulleted {
        WordListItem -Text 'Confirm stock, quote expiry and the required delivery date.'
        WordListItem -Text 'Add freight and tax before comparing landed cost.'
        WordListItem -Text 'Record the purchasing decision and its owner in the editable document.'
    }
    WordParagraph {
        WordParagraphStyle -SpacingBeforePoints 12
        WordText 'Input contract: Item, Supplier, UnitPriceUsd and LeadDays. The bundled HTML contains synthetic data.' -FontSize 10 -Color '475569'
    }
}
Export-OfficeDocumentPdf -InputPath $docx -Path $pdf

New-OfficeExcel -Path $xlsx {
    ExcelSheet 'Offers' {
        ExcelGridlines -Hide
        ExcelCell -Address A1 -Value 'Supplier offers / USD per unit'
        ExcelRow -Row 1 -Height 30 -Bold $true -FontName 'Carlito'
        ExcelCell -Address A2 -Value 'Editable numeric values; freight and tax excluded.'
        ExcelTable -InputObject $offers -StartRow 4 -TableName SupplierOffers -TableStyle TableStyleMedium2 -AutoFit
        for ($row = 5; $row -lt 5 + $offers.Count; $row++) {
            # Keep each quote's decimal places visible rather than rounding every price to cents.
            $priceText = $offers[$row - 5].UnitPriceUsd.ToString($priceTextFormat, [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
            $decimalPlaces = $priceText.Split('.')[1].Length
            ExcelCell -Row $row -Column 3 -Value $offers[$row - 5].UnitPriceUsd -NumberFormat ('0.' + ('0' * $decimalPlaces))
            ExcelRow -Row $row -Height 24
        }
        ExcelColumn -Column 1 -Width 25
        ExcelColumn -Column 2 -Width 22
        ExcelColumn -Column 3 -AutoFit
        ExcelColumn -Column 4 -Width 16
        ExcelFreeze -TopRows 4
    }
}
Get-Item -LiteralPath $docx, $pdf, $xlsx | Select-Object Name, Length

event-brief.source:
<#
.SYNOPSIS
Creates a Word/PDF incident brief and Excel event register from a bounded snapshot.
.DESCRIPTION
The default is synthetic data. -CollectLive reads recent local critical events, warnings
and errors with PSEventViewer. -Event accepts raw or typed Get-EVXEvent results.
Counts describe the retained records, not every event in the log.
.EXAMPLE
./Recipe-PSEventViewer-OfficeReport.ps1 -OutputDirectory ./Output/EventBrief
.EXAMPLE
./Recipe-PSEventViewer-OfficeReport.ps1 -CollectLive -MaxEvents 100 -OutputDirectory ./Output/LiveBrief
.EXAMPLE
$events = @(Get-EVXEvent -LogName System -Level 2,3 -TimePeriod Last24Hours -MaxEvents 100)
./Recipe-PSEventViewer-OfficeReport.ps1 -Event $events -OutputDirectory ./Output/SystemBrief
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string] $OutputDirectory,
    [object[]] $Event,
    [switch] $CollectLive,
    [ValidateNotNullOrEmpty()][string] $LogName = 'System',
    [ValidateRange(1, 1000)][int] $MaxEvents = 100
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
if (-not $OutputDirectory) { $OutputDirectory = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Output/EventBrief' }
Import-Module PSWriteOffice -MinimumVersion 3.0.8 -ErrorAction Stop
if ($CollectLive -and $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Event')) { throw 'Choose -Event or -CollectLive.' }
if ($CollectLive) {
    Import-Module PSEventViewer -MinimumVersion 4.0.1 -ErrorAction Stop
    $Event = @(Get-EVXEvent -LogName $LogName -Level 1,2,3 -TimePeriod Last24Hours -MaxEvents $MaxEvents -ReadMode Message)
    $scope = "Local $LogName critical/warning/error events / last 24 hours / newest $MaxEvents at most"
} elseif ($PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Event')) {
    $scope = "Provided event snapshot / first $MaxEvents records at most"
} else {
    $scope = 'Synthetic incident exercise / 11 October 2026'
    $Event = @(
        [pscustomobject]@{ TimeCreated = [datetime] '2026-10-11T08:10:00'; Id = 1001; ProviderName = 'Demo.Backup'; Level = 2; MachineName = 'DEMO-SRV01'; LogName = 'Application'; Message = 'The overnight backup did not complete.' }
        [pscustomobject]@{ TimeCreated = [datetime] '2026-10-11T08:12:00'; Id = 1001; ProviderName = 'Demo.Backup'; Level = 2; MachineName = 'DEMO-SRV01'; LogName = 'Application'; Message = 'The backup retry did not complete.' }
        [pscustomobject]@{ TimeCreated = [datetime] '2026-10-11T08:18:00'; Id = 2004; ProviderName = 'Demo.Inventory'; Level = 3; MachineName = 'DEMO-SRV02'; LogName = 'Application'; Message = 'The inventory queue is above its warning threshold.' }
        [pscustomobject]@{ TimeCreated = [datetime] '2026-10-11T08:25:00'; Id = 3002; ProviderName = 'Demo.Sync'; Level = 3; MachineName = 'DEMO-SRV02'; LogName = 'System'; Message = 'Synchronization completed after a retry.' }
    )
}
$records = @($Event | Select-Object -First $MaxEvents | ForEach-Object {
    # Typed rule results retain the same raw snapshot under SourceEvent.
    $envelope = $_.PSObject.Properties['SourceEvent']
    $source = if ($null -ne $envelope -and $null -ne $envelope.Value) { $envelope.Value } else { $_ }
    if (-not $source.TimeCreated -or -not $source.ProviderName -or $null -eq $source.Id -or $null -eq $source.Level) {
        throw 'Supply raw events with TimeCreated, Id, ProviderName and numeric Level, or typed results with that SourceEvent snapshot.'
    }
    $computer = $source.PSObject.Properties['MachineName']
    $log = $source.PSObject.Properties['LogName']
    $message = $source.PSObject.Properties['Message']
    [pscustomobject]@{
        TimeCreated = [datetime] $source.TimeCreated; EventId = [int] $source.Id
        Provider = [string] $source.ProviderName; Level = [int] $source.Level
        Computer = if ($computer) { [string] $computer.Value } else { '' }
        Log = if ($log) { [string] $log.Value } else { '' }
        Message = if ($message) { [string] $message.Value } else { '' }
    }
})
$computerCount = @($records | Where-Object Computer | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Computer -Unique).Count
$logCount = @($records | Where-Object Log | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Log -Unique).Count
$providerSummary = @($records | Group-Object Provider | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select-Object -First 8 | ForEach-Object {
    [pscustomobject]@{ Provider = $_.Name; Records = $_.Count; Critical = @($_.Group | Where-Object Level -EQ 1).Count; Errors = @($_.Group | Where-Object Level -EQ 2).Count; Warnings = @($_.Group | Where-Object Level -EQ 3).Count }
})
$null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $OutputDirectory -Force
$OutputDirectory = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $OutputDirectory).FullName
$docx = Join-Path $OutputDirectory 'EventIncidentBrief.docx'
$pdf = Join-Path $OutputDirectory 'EventIncidentBrief.pdf'
$xlsx = Join-Path $OutputDirectory 'EventRegister.xlsx'

New-OfficeWord -Path $docx {
    WordHeader -Type Default { WordParagraph -Text 'OPERATIONS / EVENT REVIEW' }
    WordFooter -Type Default { WordPageNumber -IncludeTotalPages }
    WordParagraph {
        WordParagraphStyle -SpacingAfterPoints 12 -KeepWithNext $true
        WordText 'Event incident brief' -Bold -FontSize 26 -Color '17365D'
    }
    WordParagraph -Text $scope
    WordParagraph {
        WordParagraphStyle -SpacingBeforePoints 12 -SpacingAfterPoints 10
        WordText "$($records.Count) retained records" -Bold -FontSize 18 -Color '9A3412'
    }
    WordParagraph -Text 'Use this snapshot to assign investigation. Event counts alone do not establish a root cause or service impact.'
    WordParagraph -Text "$computerCount named source computers / $logCount named source logs. The register preserves each record's source where supplied."
    if ($providerSummary.Count) {
        WordParagraph {
            WordParagraphStyle -SpacingBeforePoints 16 -SpacingAfterPoints 8 -KeepWithNext $true
            WordText 'Most represented providers' -Bold -FontSize 15 -Color '17365D'
        }
        $table = WordTable -InputObject $providerSummary -Style GridTable4Accent1 -Layout AutoFitToWindow -PassThru
        $table | Get-OfficeWordTableCell | ForEach-Object {
            $_.MarginTopCentimeters = 0.14; $_.MarginBottomCentimeters = 0.14
            $_.MarginLeftCentimeters = 0.16; $_.MarginRightCentimeters = 0.16
        }
    } else { WordParagraph -Text 'No matching events were returned. The workbook records that empty result.' }
    WordParagraph {
        WordParagraphStyle -SpacingBeforePoints 16 -SpacingAfterPoints 8 -KeepWithNext $true
        WordText 'Investigation handoff' -Bold -FontSize 15 -Color '17365D'
    }
    WordList -Style Numbered {
        WordListItem -Text 'Review source computers, logs, timestamps and full messages in the attached event register.'
        WordListItem -Text 'Confirm user impact and correlate the events with recent changes.'
        WordListItem -Text 'Assign an owner, record the findings and agree a follow-up time.'
    }
    WordParagraph {
        WordParagraphStyle -SpacingBeforePoints 12
        WordText 'Only the top eight providers appear here. The workbook retains every record in this bounded snapshot. Review event messages before sharing them.' -FontSize 10 -Color '475569'
    }
}
Export-OfficeDocumentPdf -InputPath $docx -Path $pdf
New-OfficeExcel -Path $xlsx {
    ExcelSheet 'Events' {
        ExcelGridlines -Hide
        ExcelCell -Address A1 -Value 'Event register'
        ExcelRow -Row 1 -Height 30 -Bold $true -FontName 'Carlito'
        ExcelCell -Address A2 -Value $scope
        if ($records.Count) {
            ExcelTable -InputObject $records -StartRow 4 -TableName EventRegister -TableStyle TableStyleMedium2
            for ($row = 5; $row -lt 5 + $records.Count; $row++) {
                ExcelCell -Row $row -Column 1 -Value $records[$row - 5].TimeCreated -NumberFormat 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss.000'
                ExcelRow -Row $row -Height 30 -WrapText $true
            }
        } else { ExcelCell -Address A4 -Value 'No matching events returned.' }
        ExcelColumn -Column 1 -Width 32
        ExcelColumn -Column 2 -Width 12
        ExcelColumn -Column 3 -Width 26
        ExcelColumn -Column 4 -Width 8
        ExcelColumn -Column 5 -Width 22
        ExcelColumn -Column 6 -Width 18
        ExcelColumn -Column 7 -Width 60
        ExcelFreeze -TopRows 4
    }
}
Get-Item -LiteralPath $docx, $pdf, $xlsx | Select-Object Name, Length

report-email.source:
<#
.SYNOPSIS
Creates a local EML review package with a PDF report or supplied attachments.
.DESCRIPTION
PSWriteOffice generates the sample PDF when no attachments are supplied.
Mailozaurr composes and saves the message. Delivery occurs only with -Send.
.EXAMPLE
./Recipe-Mailozaurr-PdfDelivery.ps1 -OutputDirectory ./Output/Mail
.EXAMPLE
./Recipe-Mailozaurr-PdfDelivery.ps1 -AttachmentPath ./Output/SupplierReview/SupplierReview.pdf,./Output/SupplierReview/SupplierOffers.xlsx -OutputDirectory ./Output/Mail
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string] $SmtpServer,
    [string] $From = 'Reporting <reporting@example.invalid>',
    [string[]] $To = @('Review team <review@example.invalid>'),
    [string] $OutputPath,
    [switch] $Send,
    [string] $OutputDirectory,
    [string[]] $AttachmentPath,
    [string] $Subject = 'Report review package',
    [ValidateRange(1, 65535)][int] $Port = 587,
    [pscredential] $Credential
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
if (-not $OutputDirectory) { $OutputDirectory = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Output/Mail' }
if ($Send -and [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($SmtpServer)) { throw '-Send requires -SmtpServer.' }
if ($PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('AttachmentPath') -and -not $AttachmentPath) { throw 'Supply at least one attachment path.' }
Import-Module Mailozaurr -MinimumVersion 3.0.2 -ErrorAction Stop
$null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $OutputDirectory -Force
$OutputDirectory = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $OutputDirectory).FullName
if (-not $AttachmentPath) {
    Import-Module PSWriteOffice -MinimumVersion 3.0.8 -ErrorAction Stop
    if (-not $OutputPath) { $OutputPath = Join-Path $OutputDirectory 'Daily-Service-Report.pdf' }
    $services = @(
        [pscustomobject]@{ Service = 'Directory'; Status = 'Healthy'; Incidents = 0 }
        [pscustomobject]@{ Service = 'Messaging'; Status = 'Attention'; Incidents = 2 }
        [pscustomobject]@{ Service = 'Database'; Status = 'Healthy'; Incidents = 0 }
    )
    New-OfficePdf -Path $OutputPath {
        PdfHeading -Text 'Daily service report' -Color '#17365D'
        PdfSpacer -Height 12
        PdfParagraph -Text 'Synthetic operations snapshot / review before distribution' -Color '#475569'
        PdfSpacer -Height 14
        PdfTable -InputObject $services
        PdfSpacer -Height 14
        PdfParagraph -Text 'Next action: confirm the messaging incident owner and the agreed follow-up time.'
    }
    $AttachmentPath = @($OutputPath)
}
$attachments = @($AttachmentPath | ForEach-Object {
    $file = Get-Item -LiteralPath $_ -ErrorAction Stop
    if ($file.PSIsContainer) { throw "An attachment must be a file: $_" }
    $file.FullName
})
$text = @'
Hello,

Please review the attached report and any editable registers.
Confirm the findings, decision owner and next action before distribution.

This EML is a local review package. Open it in a mail client to inspect its recipients and attachments.
'@
$messageId = '<{0}@example.invalid>' -f [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')
$message = New-MimeMessage -From $From -To $To -Subject $Subject -AttachmentPath $attachments -TextBody $text -Header @{ 'Message-Id' = $messageId }
$path = Join-Path $OutputDirectory 'ReportReview.eml'
$message | Save-MimeMessage -Path $path
Get-Item -LiteralPath $path | Select-Object Name, Length

if ($Send) {
    $mail = @{
        Server = $SmtpServer; Port = $Port; From = $From; To = $To
        Subject = $Subject; Text = $text; Attachment = $attachments
        SecureSocketOptions = 'StartTls'
    }
    if ($Credential) { $mail.Credential = $Credential }
    Send-EmailMessage @mail
}
